verse_translation.life_application: Offer your small daily sacrifices with high intention, dedicating your efforts to universal well-being.

verse.transliteration:
śrotrādīnīndriyāṇyanye saṃyamāgniṣu juhvati .
śabdādīnviṣayānanya indriyāgniṣu juhvati ||4-26||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति |
शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति ||४-२६||

verse_translation.life_application: Practice sensory discipline today by filtering out noise, gossip, and harmful sights from your daily awareness.

verse.transliteration:
sarvāṇīndriyakarmāṇi prāṇakarmāṇi cāpare .
ātmasaṃyamayogāgnau juhvati jñānadīpite ||4-27||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे |
आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते ||४-२७||

verse_translation.life_application: Bring your physical breath and sensory habits under gentle conscious control through regular quiet meditation.

verse.transliteration:
dravyayajñāstapoyajñā yogayajñāstathāpare .
svādhyāyajñānayajñāśca yatayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ||4-28||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथापरे |
स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः ||४-२८||

verse_translation.life_application: Choose a form of self-discipline that fits your life, whether through charity, quiet study, or personal restraint.

verse.transliteration:
apāne juhvati prāṇaṃ prāṇe.apānaṃ tathāpare .
prāṇāpānagatī ruddhvā prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇāḥ ||4-29||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अपाने जुह्वति प्राणं प्राणेऽपानं तथापरे |
प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः ||४-२९||

verse_translation.life_application: Use conscious breathing exercises during moments of stress to restore physical calm and mental clarity.

verse.transliteration:
apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇānprāṇeṣu juhvati .
sarve.apyete yajñavido yajñakṣapitakalmaṣāḥ ||4-30||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति |
सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषाः ||४-३०||

verse_translation.life_application: Practice moderation in eating and consumption, purifying your body and mind through intentional habits.

verse.transliteration:
yajñaśiṣṭāmṛtabhujo yānti brahma sanātanam .
nāyaṃ loko.astyayajñasya kuto.anyaḥ kurusattama ||4-31||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम् |
नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतोऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम ||४-३१||

verse_translation.life_application: Live generously by offering your best before partaking, knowing that a life without sacrifice brings no true joy.

verse.transliteration:
evaṃ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe .
karmajānviddhi tānsarvānevaṃ jñātvā vimokṣyase ||4-32||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे |
कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे ||४-३२||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand that all constructive human actions can serve as spiritual practices when performed with noble intent.

verse.transliteration:
śreyāndravyamayādyajñājjñānayajñaḥ parantapa .
sarvaṃ karmākhilaṃ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate ||4-33||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप |
सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते ||४-३३||

verse_translation.life_application: Value the pursuit of spiritual wisdom above accumulating material goods, as understanding completes all human effort.

verse.transliteration:
tadviddhi praṇipātena paripraśnena sevayā .
upadekṣyanti te jñānaṃ jñāninastattvadarśinaḥ ||4-34||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया |
उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः ||४-३४||

verse_translation.life_application: Approach wise teachers with genuine humility, respectful questions, and willing service to gain deep life insight.

verse.transliteration:
yajjñātvā na punarmohamevaṃ yāsyasi pāṇḍava .
yena bhūtānyaśeṣāṇi drakṣyasyātmanyatho mayi ||4-35||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव |
येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि (var अशेषाणि) ||४-३५||

verse_translation.life_application: See the underlying unity of all living beings in God, overcoming feelings of isolation and division.

verse.transliteration:
api cedasi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ .
sarvaṃ jñānaplavenaiva vṛjinaṃ santariṣyasi ||4-36||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः |
सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि ||४-३६||

verse_translation.life_application: Never give up hope over past mistakes, trusting that spiritual wisdom has the power to transform any life.

verse.transliteration:
yathaidhāṃsi samiddho.agnirbhasmasātkurute.arjuna .
jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasātkurute tathā ||4-37||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन |
ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा ||४-३७||

verse_translation.life_application: Let the fire of self-knowledge consume your past guilt, regrets, and limiting beliefs today.

verse.transliteration:
na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitramiha vidyate .
tatsvayaṃ yogasaṃsiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati ||4-38||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते |
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति ||४-३८||

verse_translation.life_application: Cultivate spiritual understanding patiently through daily practice, trusting that self-knowledge will blossom naturally within you.

verse.transliteration:
śraddhāvā.Nllabhate jñānaṃ tatparaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ .
jñānaṃ labdhvā parāṃ śāntimacireṇādhigacchati ||4-39||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः |
ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति ||४-३९||

verse_translation.life_application: Combine steady faith, focused devotion, and sensory control to experience deep, lasting inner peace.

verse.transliteration:
ajñaścāśraddadhānaśca saṃśayātmā vinaśyati .
nāyaṃ loko.asti na paro na sukhaṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ ||4-40||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति |
नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः ||४-४०||

verse_translation.life_application: Overcome persistent self-doubt and cynicism, cultivating healthy trust so you can experience peace and happiness.

verse.transliteration:
yogasaṃnyastakarmāṇaṃ jñānasañchinnasaṃśayam .
ātmavantaṃ na karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya ||4-41||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसञ्छिन्नसंशयम् |
आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय ||४-४१||

verse_translation.life_application: Dispel your doubts through study and practice, performing your daily work with complete inner freedom.

verse.transliteration:
tasmādajñānasambhūtaṃ hṛtsthaṃ jñānāsinātmanaḥ .
chittvainaṃ saṃśayaṃ yogamātiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhārata ||4-42||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
तस्मादज्ञानसम्भूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनात्मनः |
छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत ||४-४२||

verse_translation.life_application: Cut through lingering doubts with the sword of self-knowledge, standing up courageously to fulfill your life's purpose.

verse.transliteration: OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde jñānakarmasaṃnyāsayogo nāma caturtho.adhyāyaḥ ||4-43||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
ज्ञानकर्मसंन्यासयोगो नाम चतुर्थोऽध्यायः ||४||

verse_translation.life_application: Integrate action and knowledge into a unified lifestyle, letting spiritual wisdom guide your everyday choices.

verse.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca .
saṃnyāsaṃ karmaṇāṃ kṛṣṇa punaryogaṃ ca śaṃsasi .
yacchreya etayorekaṃ tanme brūhi suniścitam ||5-1||

verse_text.speaker: अर्जुन
verse_text.slok:
अर्जुन उवाच |
संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि |
यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्चितम् ||५-१||

verse_translation.life_application: Ask for clear, decisive guidance when choosing between stepping back from responsibilities and taking active, dedicated action.

verse.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca .
saṃnyāsaḥ karmayogaśca niḥśreyasakarāvubhau .
tayostu karmasaṃnyāsātkarmayogo viśiṣyate ||5-2||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ |
तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते ||५-२||

verse_translation.life_application: Choose active, unselfish service over passive withdrawal, knowing that dedicated work is easier and brings higher fulfillment.

verse.transliteration:
jñeyaḥ sa nityasaṃnyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati .
nirdvandvo hi mahābāho sukhaṃ bandhātpramucyate ||5-3||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति |
निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते ||५-३||

verse_translation.life_application: Cultivate inner renunciation by letting go of personal hatred and selfish craving while carrying out your daily tasks.

verse.transliteration:
sāṅkhyayogau pṛthagbālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ .
ekamapyāsthitaḥ samyagubhayorvindate phalam ||5-4||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
साङ्ख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः |
एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम् ||५-४||

verse_translation.life_application: Recognize that honest spiritual study and selfless daily work ultimately lead to the same deep inner peace.

verse.transliteration:
yatsāṅkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṃ tadyogairapi gamyate .
ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati ||5-5||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यत्साङ्ख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते |
एकं साङ्ख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति ||५-५||

verse_translation.life_application: Unify your intellectual insights and practical efforts, seeing them as complementary steps toward a single spiritual goal.

verse.transliteration:
saṃnyāsastu mahābāho duḥkhamāptumayogataḥ .
yogayukto munirbrahma nacireṇādhigacchati ||5-6||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः |
योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति ||५-६||

verse_translation.life_application: Engage in unselfish action first to purify your mind before attempting quiet, solitary contemplative practices.

verse.transliteration:
yogayukto viśuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ .
sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā kurvannapi na lipyate ||5-7||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः |
सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते ||५-७||

verse_translation.life_application: Keep your mind pure and senses disciplined while serving others, seeing the same divine life in everyone.

verse.transliteration:
naiva kiñcitkaromīti yukto manyeta tattvavit .
paśyañśruṇvanspṛśañjighrannaśnangacchansvapañśvasan ||5-8||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
नैव किञ्चित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित् |
पश्यञ्शृण्वन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपञ्श्वसन् ||५-८||

verse_translation.life_application: Remember that your physical senses automatically process experiences while your true inner observer remains serene and untouched.

verse.transliteration:
pralapanvisṛjangṛhṇannunmiṣannimiṣannapi .
indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan ||5-9||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि |
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन् ||५-९||

verse_translation.life_application: Observe your bodily movements and sensory functions calmly today without claiming personal ego-driven ownership over them.

verse.transliteration:
brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ .
lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā ||5-10||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः |
लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ||५-१०||

verse_translation.life_application: Offer your work to the divine presence, remaining untouched by worldly troubles just as a lotus leaf repels water.

verse.transliteration:
kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalairindriyairapi .
yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṃ tyaktvātmaśuddhaye ||5-11||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि |
योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये ||५-११||

verse_translation.life_application: Use your daily work as an instrument for mental purification, acting with care while releasing selfish attachment.

verse.transliteration:
yuktaḥ karmaphalaṃ tyaktvā śāntimāpnoti naiṣṭhikīm .
ayuktaḥ kāmakāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate ||5-12||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम् |
अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते ||५-१२||

verse_translation.life_application: Trade the chronic anxiety of desire-driven work for the lasting peace that comes from surrendering outcome expectations.

verse.transliteration:
sarvakarmāṇi manasā saṃnyasyāste sukhaṃ vaśī .
navadvāre pure dehī naiva kurvanna kārayan ||5-13||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी |
नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन् ||५-१३||

verse_translation.life_application: Rest peacefully in your inner awareness, realizing your true self is the quiet witness within your physical body.

verse.transliteration:
na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛjati prabhuḥ .
na karmaphalasaṃyogaṃ svabhāvastu pravartate ||5-14||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः |
न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते ||५-१४||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand that natural laws govern physical events, freeing your mind from false pride or misplaced guilt.

verse.transliteration:
nādatte kasyacitpāpaṃ na caiva sukṛtaṃ vibhuḥ .
ajñānenāvṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ ||5-15||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः |
अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः ||५-१५||

verse_translation.life_application: Dispel personal delusion by recognizing that divine presence remains untainted by human errors or passing claims.

verse.transliteration:
jñānena tu tadajñānaṃ yeṣāṃ nāśitamātmanaḥ .
teṣāmādityavajjñānaṃ prakāśayati tatparam ||5-16||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः |
तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम् ||५-१६||

verse_translation.life_application: Let the light of self-knowledge illuminate your mind today, dispelling doubts and fears like the morning sun.

verse.transliteration:
tadbuddhayastadātmānastanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ .
gacchantyapunarāvṛttiṃ jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ ||5-17||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः |
गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः ||५-१७||

verse_translation.life_application: Fix your mind and devotion on the ultimate truth, letting spiritual clarity wash away all accumulated mental impurities.

verse.transliteration:
vidyāvinayasampanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini .
śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ ||5-18||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
विद्याविनयसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि |
शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः ||५-१८||

verse_translation.life_application: Treat all living beings with equal respect and compassion today, looking past external appearances to the shared spirit within.

verse.transliteration:
ihaiva tairjitaḥ sargo yeṣāṃ sāmye sthitaṃ manaḥ .
nirdoṣaṃ hi samaṃ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ ||5-19||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः |
निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः ||५-१९||

verse_translation.life_application: Conquer daily stress by cultivating an even mind, remaining grounded in the calm equality of divine awareness.

verse.transliteration:
na prahṛṣyetpriyaṃ prāpya nodvijetprāpya cāpriyam .
sthirabuddhirasammūḍho brahmavid brahmaṇi sthitaḥ ||5-20||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम् |
स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद् ब्रह्मणि स्थितः ||५-२०||

verse_translation.life_application: Maintain your mental balance today whether you receive good news or bad news, refusing to be swept away by emotions.

verse.transliteration:
bāhyasparśeṣvasaktātmā vindatyātmani yatsukham .
sa brahmayogayuktātmā sukhamakṣayamaśnute ||5-21||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम् |
स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते ||५-२१||

verse_translation.life_application: Look inward for true happiness rather than relying on external sensory thrills that quickly fade away.

verse.transliteration:
ye hi saṃsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te .
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ ||5-22||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते |
आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः ||५-२२||

verse_translation.life_application: Recognize that pleasures dependent on physical objects are temporary, avoiding excessive attachment to fleeting comforts.

verse.transliteration:
śaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṃ prākśarīravimokṣaṇāt .
kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ vegaṃ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ ||5-23||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात् |
कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः ||५-२३||

verse_translation.life_application: Practice impulse control when sudden anger or intense desire arises, experiencing the strength of true inner freedom.

verse.transliteration:
yo.antaḥsukho.antarārāmastathāntarjyotireva yaḥ .
sa yogī brahmanirvāṇaṃ brahmabhūto.adhigacchati ||5-24||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः |
स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति ||५-२४||

verse_translation.life_application: Discover the joy of your own quiet inner presence, letting self-illumination guide your daily choices and interactions.

verse.transliteration:
labhante brahmanirvāṇamṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ .
chinnadvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||5-25||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः |
छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः ||५-२५||

verse_translation.life_application: Dedicate yourself to the well-being of all creatures while working to eliminate personal faults and doubts.

verse.transliteration:
kāmakrodhaviyuktānāṃ yatīnāṃ yatacetasām .
abhito brahmanirvāṇaṃ vartate viditātmanām ||5-26||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम् |
अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम् ||५-२६||

verse_translation.life_application: Free your mind from craving and hostility, experiencing peaceful freedom right here in your current surroundings.

verse.transliteration:
sparśānkṛtvā bahirbāhyāṃścakṣuścaivāntare bhruvoḥ .
prāṇāpānau samau kṛtvā nāsābhyantaracāriṇau ||5-27||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः |
प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ ||५-२७||

verse_translation.life_application: Take time for quiet meditation, drawing your attention inward and balancing your breath to calm your nervous system.

verse.transliteration:
yatendriyamanobuddhirmunirmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ .
vigatecchābhayakrodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ ||5-28||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः |
विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः ||५-२८||

verse_translation.life_application: Govern your thoughts and emotions deliberately, releasing fear, desire, and resentment to abide in permanent freedom.

verse.transliteration:
bhoktāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram .
suhṛdaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jñātvā māṃ śāntimṛcchati ||5-29||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् |
सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति ||५-२९||

verse_translation.life_application: Remember that God is the loving friend of all living beings, resting in the deep comfort of divine protection.

verse.transliteration: OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde saṃnyāsayogo nāma pañcamo.adhyāyaḥ ||5-30||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
संन्यासयोगो नाम पञ्चमोऽध्यायः ||५||

verse_translation.life_application: Integrate outer duties with inner renunciation, letting every action deepen your spiritual peace and freedom.

verse.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca .
anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ .
sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ ||6-1||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः |
स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः ||६-१||

verse_translation.life_application: Perform your required work without depending on the rewards, living as a true practitioner of inner renunciation.

verse.transliteration:
yaṃ saṃnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava .
na hyasaṃnyastasaṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaścana ||6-2||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव |
न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन ||६-२||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand that true spiritual practice requires giving up selfish planning and obsessive personal motives.

verse.transliteration:
ārurukṣormuneryogaṃ karma kāraṇamucyate .
yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇamucyate ||6-3||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते |
योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते ||६-३||

verse_translation.life_application: Use unselfish action to climb the spiritual ladder, and quiet contemplation to maintain inner stability once established.

verse.transliteration:
yadā hi nendriyārtheṣu na karmasvanuṣajjate .
sarvasaṅkalpasaṃnyāsī yogārūḍhastadocyate ||6-4||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते |
सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते ||६-४||

verse_translation.life_application: Free your mind from attachment to sensory enjoyment and selfish projects to become truly established in meditation.

verse.transliteration:
uddharedātmanātmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet .
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ ||6-5||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् |
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ||६-५||

verse_translation.life_application: Uplift yourself through your own mental discipline, refusing to degrade yourself, for you are your own friend or enemy.

verse.transliteration:
bandhurātmātmanastasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ .
anātmanastu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatruvat ||6-6||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः |
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत् ||६-६||

verse_translation.life_application: Master your mind so it becomes your best ally, rather than letting an undisciplined mind act as your worst enemy.

verse.transliteration:
jitātmanaḥ praśāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ .
śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ ||6-7||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः |
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः ||६-७||

verse_translation.life_application: Remain serene and self-possessed in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, honor and dishonor, centered in divine awareness.

verse.transliteration:
jñānavijñānatṛptātmā kūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ .
yukta ityucyate yogī samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ ||6-8||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः |
युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ||६-८||

verse_translation.life_application: Seek inner contentment through wisdom, viewing a clod of earth, a stone, and gold with equal detachment.

verse.transliteration:
suhṛnmitrāryudāsīnamadhyasthadveṣyabandhuṣu .
sādhuṣvapi ca pāpeṣu samabuddhirviśiṣyate ||6-9||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु |
साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते ||६-९||

verse_translation.life_application: Excel in spiritual maturity by maintaining equal goodwill toward well-wishers, friends, enemies, strangers, saints, and sinners.

verse.transliteration:
yogī yuñjīta satatamātmānaṃ rahasi sthitaḥ .
ekākī yatacittātmā nirāśīraparigrahaḥ ||6-10||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः |
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः ||६-१०||

verse_translation.life_application: Set aside regular time in a quiet space to center your mind, free from cravings and possessiveness.

verse.transliteration:
śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ .
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ cailājinakuśottaram ||6-11||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः |
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ||६-११||

verse_translation.life_application: Arrange a clean, stable, and comfortable meditation seat in a quiet place free from unnecessary distractions.

verse.transliteration:
tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yatacittendriyakriyaḥ .
upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye ||6-12||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः |
उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये ||६-१२||

verse_translation.life_application: Sit quietly with a single-pointed focus, curbing your thoughts and senses to purify your inner awareness.

verse.transliteration:
samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvaṃ dhārayannacalaṃ sthiraḥ .
samprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan ||6-13||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः |
सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् ||६-१३||

verse_translation.life_application: Hold your body, neck, and head erect and still, focusing your gaze inward to settle your wandering attention.

verse.transliteration:
praśāntātmā vigatabhīrbrahmacārivrate sthitaḥ .
manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ ||6-14||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः |
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ||६-१४||

verse_translation.life_application: Calm your heart, cast away fear, practice self-restraint, and sit with your mind absorbed in divine contemplation.

verse.transliteration:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ .
śāntiṃ nirvāṇaparamāṃ matsaṃsthāmadhigacchati ||6-15||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी नियतमानसः |
शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति ||६-१५||

verse_translation.life_application: Keep your mind steadily disciplined through regular practice to experience supreme peace and spiritual liberation.

verse.transliteration:
nātyaśnatastu yogo.asti na caikāntamanaśnataḥ .
na cātisvapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna ||6-16||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः |
न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन ||६-१६||

verse_translation.life_application: Avoid extremes in eating and sleeping, maintaining healthy balance in all your physical habits today.

verse.transliteration:
yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu .
yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā ||6-17||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु |
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ||६-१७||

verse_translation.life_application: Regulate your food, recreation, effort in work, and sleep schedule to eliminate physical and mental suffering.

verse.transliteration:
yadā viniyataṃ cittamātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate .
niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyo yukta ityucyate tadā ||6-18||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते |
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा ||६-१८||

verse_translation.life_application: Rest established in self-awareness when your disciplined mind becomes free from craving for all sensory desires.

verse.transliteration:
yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā .
yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogamātmanaḥ ||6-19||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता |
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः ||६-१९||

verse_translation.life_application: Keep your mind steady like a candle flame in a windless place during your daily quiet contemplation.

verse.transliteration:
yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā .
yatra caivātmanātmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati ||6-20||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया |
यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति ||६-२०||

verse_translation.life_application: Experience the quiet joy of a quieted mind where thought ceases and you behold your true inner self.

verse.transliteration:
sukhamātyantikaṃ yattad buddhigrāhyamatīndriyam .
vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ ||6-21||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् |
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ||६-२१||

verse_translation.life_application: Taste the boundless joy that lies beyond sensory pleasures, remaining firm in truth without ever wavering.

verse.transliteration:
yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ .
yasminsthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate ||6-22||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः |
यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते ||६-२२||

verse_translation.life_application: Grasp that spiritual fulfillment is the greatest treasure, which no heavy sorrow or trial can ever disturb.

verse.transliteration:
taṃ vidyād duḥkhasaṃyogaviyogaṃ yogasaṃjñitam .
sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo.anirviṇṇacetasā ||6-23||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् |
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा ||६-२३||

verse_translation.life_application: Practice meditation with unyielding determination and hope, breaking free from all association with pain and suffering.

verse.transliteration:
saṅkalpaprabhavānkāmāṃstyaktvā sarvānaśeṣataḥ .
manasaivendriyagrāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ ||6-24||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः |
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः ||६-२४||

verse_translation.life_application: Abandon all desires born of imagination, completely restraining your senses from all sides using your conscious mind.

verse.transliteration:
śanaiḥ śanairuparamed buddhyā dhṛtigṛhītayā .
ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet ||6-25||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया |
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत् ||६-२५||

verse_translation.life_application: Gain inner quiet step by step using a patient intellect, fixing your mind on the Self without thinking of anything else.

verse.transliteration:
yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram .
tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet ||6-26||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् |
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ||६-२६||

verse_translation.life_application: Whenever your restless mind wanders away today, gently bring it back under the control of self-awareness.

verse.transliteration:
praśāntamanasaṃ hyenaṃ yoginaṃ sukhamuttamam .
upaiti śāntarajasaṃ brahmabhūtamakalmaṣam ||6-27||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम् |
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम् ||६-२७||

verse_translation.life_application: Experience supreme peace as your mind grows tranquil, your passions settle, and your heart rests in purity.

verse.transliteration:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ .
sukhena brahmasaṃsparśamatyantaṃ sukhamaśnute ||6-28||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः |
सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते ||६-२८||

verse_translation.life_application: Engage in regular self-alignment to touch the infinite bliss of divine presence easily and continuously.

verse.transliteration:
sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani .
īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ ||6-29||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि |
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ||६-२९||

verse_translation.life_application: See the divine presence in all beings and all beings in the divine presence, cultivating universal empathy.

verse.transliteration:
yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati .
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ||6-30||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति |
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ||६-३०||

verse_translation.life_application: Realize that one who sees God everywhere and sees everything in God is never separated from divine love.

verse.transliteration:
sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajatyekatvamāsthitaḥ .
sarvathā vartamāno.api sa yogī mayi vartate ||6-31||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः |
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते ||६-३१||

verse_translation.life_application: Worship the divine presence dwelling in all beings, living in spiritual unity no matter your daily circumstances.

verse.transliteration:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo.arjuna .
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ ||6-32||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन |
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ||६-३२||

verse_translation.life_application: Treat the joy and sorrow of others as your own, reaching the highest standard of spiritual empathy.

verse.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca .
yo.ayaṃ yogastvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana .
etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvātsthitiṃ sthirām ||6-33||

verse_text.speaker: अर्जुन
verse_text.slok:
अर्जुन उवाच |
योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन |
एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात्स्थितिं स्थिराम् ||६-३३||

verse_translation.life_application: Acknowledge how difficult it is to keep a restless mind steady when trying to maintain continuous equanimity.

verse.transliteration:
cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavad dṛḍham .
tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyoriva suduṣkaram ||6-34||

verse_text.speaker: अर्जुन
verse_text.slok:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद् दृढम् |
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम् ||६-३४||

verse_translation.life_application: Recognize that the mind is turbulent, powerful, and stubborn, requiring patient effort to harness like the wind.

verse.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca .
asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calam .
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate ||6-35||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् |
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ||६-३५||

verse_translation.life_application: Master your restless mind through steady practice and mental detachment, refusing to give up when progress feels slow.

verse.transliteration:
asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ .
vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo.avāptumupāyataḥ ||6-36||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः |
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः ||६-३६||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand that self-mastery is hard for the undisciplined, but achievable for one who strives using proper methods.

verse.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca .
ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasaḥ .
aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati ||6-37||

verse_text.speaker: अर्जुन
verse_text.slok:
अर्जुन उवाच |
अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः |
अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति ||६-३७||

verse_translation.life_application: Ask with trust about the fate of an earnest seeker who strays from practice due to an un-mastered mind.

verse.transliteration:
kaccinnobhayavibhraṣṭaśchinnābhramiva naśyati .
apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi ||6-38||

verse_text.speaker: अर्जुन
verse_text.slok:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति |
अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि ||६-३८||

verse_translation.life_application: Inquire whether a confused seeker who falls short in spiritual practice is destroyed like a scattered cloud.

verse.transliteration:
etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ .
tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hyupapadyate ||6-39||

verse_text.speaker: अर्जुन
verse_text.slok:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः |
त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते ||६-३९||

verse_translation.life_application: Seek complete clarity from wise spiritual guidance to dissolve your deepest doubts about your life's journey.

verse.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca .
pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśastasya vidyate .
na hi kalyāṇakṛtkaścid durgatiṃ tāta gacchati ||6-40||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते |
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ||६-४०||

verse_translation.life_application: Rest assured that no good effort is ever lost, and one who strives for righteousness never meets a tragic end.

verse.transliteration:
prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ .
śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo.abhijāyate ||6-41||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः |
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते ||६-४१||

verse_translation.life_application: Trust that incomplete spiritual effort earns a favorable rebirth in a pure and prosperous home to resume progress.

verse.transliteration:
athavā yogināmeva kule bhavati dhīmatām .
etaddhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yadīdṛśam ||6-42||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् |
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम् ||६-४२||

verse_translation.life_application: Value being born into a family of wise spiritual practitioners as a rare and precious opportunity for growth.

verse.transliteration:
tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam .
yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana ||6-43||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् |
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन ||६-४३||

verse_translation.life_application: Reawaken your accumulated wisdom from past efforts, striving with renewed energy toward complete spiritual fulfillment.

verse.transliteration:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśo.api saḥ .
jijñāsurapi yogasya śabdabrahmātivartate ||6-44||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः |
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते ||६-४४||

verse_translation.life_application: Allow your innate spiritual inclination to carry you forward, rising above mere ritualistic rules.

verse.transliteration:
prayatnādyatamānastu yogī saṃśuddhakilbiṣaḥ .
anekajanmasaṃsiddhastato yāti parāṃ gatim ||6-45||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः |
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ||६-४५||

verse_translation.life_application: Strive with patient effort across time, purifying your heart until you reach the ultimate spiritual goal.

verse.transliteration:
tapasvibhyo.adhiko yogī jñānibhyo.api mato.adhikaḥ .
karmibhyaścādhiko yogī tasmādyogī bhavārjuna ||6-46||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः |
कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन ||६-४६||

verse_translation.life_application: Aspire to become a true practitioner of inner discipline, rising above mere austerity or dry intellectual study.

verse.transliteration:
yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā .
śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ ||6-47||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना |
श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ||६-४७||

verse_translation.life_application: Offer your deepest faith and love to the divine presence, becoming the most devoted and centered of all practitioners.

verse.transliteration: OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde ātmasaṃyamayogo nāma ṣaṣṭho.adhyāyaḥ ||6-48||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
आत्मसंयमयोगो नाम षष्ठोऽध्यायः ||६||

verse_translation.life_application: Endeavor to master your mind and meditation, letting inner stillness guide your journey through all life's challenges.

verse.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca .
mayyāsaktamanāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjanmadāśrayaḥ .
asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu ||7-1||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः |
असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ||७-१||

verse_translation.life_application: Listen attentively to divine wisdom with your mind attached to God, taking refuge in practice to know truth completely.

verse.transliteration:
jñānaṃ te.ahaṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ .
yajjñātvā neha bhūyo.anyajjñātavyamavaśiṣyate ||7-2||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः |
यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते ||७-२||

verse_translation.life_application: Seek both intellectual knowledge and direct spiritual experience, after which nothing more remains to be known.

verse.transliteration:
manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaścidyatati siddhaye .
yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaścinmāṃ vetti tattvataḥ ||7-3||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये |
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ||७-३||

verse_translation.life_application: Persevere in your spiritual pursuit, realizing that among thousands of people, only a few strive for ultimate truth.

verse.transliteration:
bhūmirāpo.analo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca .
ahaṃkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā ||7-4||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च |
अहंकार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा ||७-४||

verse_translation.life_application: Recognize the eightfold elements of physical nature—earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and ego.

verse.transliteration:
apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām .
jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat ||7-5||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम् |
जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ||७-५||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand your higher spiritual nature that sustains life, distinct from the lower physical elements of creation.

verse.transliteration:
etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya .
ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā ||7-6||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय |
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा ||७-६||

verse_translation.life_application: Realize that all living beings originate from divine energy, which is the source and dissolution of the entire universe.

verse.transliteration:
mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiñcidasti dhanañjaya .
mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva ||7-7||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय |
मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ||७-७||

verse_translation.life_application: Rest in the truth that nothing is superior to God, upon whom all creation is strung like pearls on a thread.

verse.transliteration:
raso.ahamapsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ .
praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu ||7-8||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः |
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु ||७-८||

verse_translation.life_application: Perceive the divine presence as the taste in water, light in sun and moon, sacred sound in air, and manhood in men.

verse.transliteration:
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau .
jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścāsmi tapasviṣu ||7-9||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ |
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु ||७-९||

verse_translation.life_application: Sense God as the sweet fragrance in earth, brilliance in fire, life in all beings, and austerity in spiritual seekers.

verse.transliteration:
bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam .
buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham ||7-10||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् |
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ||७-१०||

verse_translation.life_application: Know the divine as the eternal seed of all beings, the intelligence of the intelligent, and radiance of the splendid.

verse.transliteration:
balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam .
dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo.asmi bharatarṣabha ||7-11||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम् |
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ ||७-११||

verse_translation.life_application: Express strength that is free from lust and passion, and desire that accords with righteousness and duty.

verse.transliteration:
ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye .
matta eveti tānviddhi na tvahaṃ teṣu te mayi ||7-12||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये |
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि ||७-१२||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand that all states of goodness, passion, and ignorance originate from God, but God transcends them all.

verse.transliteration:
tribhirguṇamayairbhāvairebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat .
mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam ||7-13||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् |
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम् ||७-१३||

verse_translation.life_application: Look beyond the delusion caused by the three modes of nature, recognizing the unchangeable supreme spirit beyond them.

verse.transliteration:
daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā .
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te ||7-14||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया |
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ||७-१४||

verse_translation.life_application: Surrender to divine grace to cross over the formidable illusion of material nature that is otherwise hard to overcome.

verse.transliteration:
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ .
māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ ||7-15||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः |
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः ||७-१५||

verse_translation.life_application: Avoid the trap of evil conduct and ignorance that robs people of wisdom and leads them into destructive mindsets.

verse.transliteration:
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino.arjuna .
ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha ||7-16||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन |
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ ||७-१६||

verse_translation.life_application: Turn to God whether you are in distress, seeking prosperity, asking deep questions, or searching for pure wisdom.

verse.transliteration:
teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhaktirviśiṣyate .
priyo hi jñānino.atyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ ||7-17||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते |
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ||७-१७||

verse_translation.life_application: Cultivate wise and steadfast devotion, knowing that one who loves God with single-pointed understanding is deeply cherished.

verse.transliteration:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam .
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim ||7-18||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् |
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ||७-१८||

verse_translation.life_application: Respect all sincere seekers, while striving to become established in steady devotion to the supreme goal.

verse.transliteration:
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavānmāṃ prapadyate .
vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ ||7-19||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते |
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः ||७-१९||

verse_translation.life_application: After many lives of learning, surrender to the truth that the divine presence is everything, a rare and great soul.

verse.transliteration:
kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante.anyadevatāḥ .
taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā ||7-20||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः |
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ||७-२०||

verse_translation.life_application: Recognize how personal desires can lead people to worship temporary forces according to their own nature.

verse.transliteration:
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati .
tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tāmeva vidadhāmyaham ||7-21||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति |
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम् ||७-२१||

verse_translation.life_application: Appreciate how God strengthens the faith of every devotee, whichever form of the divine they choose to worship.

verse.transliteration:
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate .
labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaivavihitānhi tān ||7-22||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते |
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् ||७-२२||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand that benefits obtained through lesser desires are ultimately granted by the one supreme divine source.

verse.transliteration:
antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām .
devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi ||7-23||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् |
देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि ||७-२३||

verse_translation.life_application: Seek eternal spiritual fulfillment rather than temporary rewards that fade away with time.

verse.transliteration:
avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ .
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayamanuttamam ||7-24||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः |
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम् ||७-२४||

verse_translation.life_application: Do not mistake the unmanifest supreme divine reality for a mere temporary physical form.

verse.transliteration:
nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ .
mūḍho.ayaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavyayam ||7-25||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः |
मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम् ||७-२५||

verse_translation.life_application: Realize that divine truth remains hidden from those blinded by worldly illusion, unveiled only through devotion.

verse.transliteration:
vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna .
bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana ||7-26||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन |
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन ||७-२६||

verse_translation.life_application: Trust in the omniscient divine presence that knows all past, present, and future beings, even when we fail to know It.

verse.transliteration:
icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata .
sarvabhūtāni sammohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa ||7-27||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत |
सर्वभूतानि सम्मोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप ||७-२७||

verse_translation.life_application: Beware of the dualities of attraction and aversion born of delusion, which confuse all living beings from birth.

verse.transliteration:
yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām .
te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ ||7-28||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् |
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः ||७-२८||

verse_translation.life_application: Worship God with firm resolve when your pious deeds have cleansed away past sins and freed you from dualities.

verse.transliteration:
jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye .
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam ||7-29||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये |
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ||७-२९||

verse_translation.life_application: Strive for liberation from old age and death by taking refuge in God, knowing complete spiritual wisdom and action.

verse.transliteration:
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ .
prayāṇakāle.api ca māṃ te viduryuktacetasaḥ ||7-30||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः |
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ||७-३०||

verse_translation.life_application: Know God as the governing principle of all physical elements, divine forces, and sacrifices, remaining conscious at death.

verse.transliteration: OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde jñānavijñānayogo nāma saptamo.adhyāyaḥ ||7-31||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
ज्ञानविज्ञानयोगो नाम सप्तमोऽध्यायः ||७||

verse_translation.life_application: Anchor your awareness in divine truth so that even at the moment of passing, your mind remains steady and free.

verse.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca .
kiṃ tad brahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama .
adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktamadhidaivaṃ kimucyate ||8-1||

verse_text.speaker: अर्जुन
verse_text.slok:
अर्जुन उवाच |
किं तद् ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम |
अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते ||८-१||

verse_translation.life_application: Inquire earnestly about Brahman, the Self, action, material realm, divine realm, and the Lord of sacrifice.

verse.transliteration:
adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko.atra dehe.asminmadhusūdana .
prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo.asi niyatātmabhiḥ ||8-2||

verse_text.speaker: अर्जुन
verse_text.slok:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन |
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः ||८-२||

verse_translation.life_application: Ask how the supreme Lord resides in the body and how a self-controlled person remembers Him at death.

verse.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca .
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo.adhyātmamucyate .
bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ ||8-3||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते |
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ||८-३||

verse_translation.life_application: Know Brahman as the supreme imperishable entity, the Self as innate nature, and action as the creative force of life.

verse.transliteration:
adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivatam .
adhiyajño.ahamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara ||8-4||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् |
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर ||८-४||

verse_translation.life_application: Recognize physical nature as perishable, the divine person as cosmic spirit, and God as the inner sacrifice in the body.

verse.transliteration:
antakāle ca māmeva smaranmuktvā kalevaram .
yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||8-5||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् |
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ||८-५||

verse_translation.life_application: Remember God at the time of leaving your body to attain the divine state without any doubt.

verse.transliteration:
yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram .
taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ ||8-6||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् |
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः ||८-६||

verse_translation.life_application: Be mindful of your daily thoughts, for whatever state of being you remember at death determines your next state.

verse.transliteration:
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca .
mayyarpitamanobuddhirmāmevaiṣyasyasaṃśayaḥ ||8-7||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च |
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयः (orसंशयम्) ||८-७||

verse_translation.life_application: Remember God constantly at all times while performing your duty; with mind and intellect dedicated, you will reach Him.

verse.transliteration:
orsaṃśayama abhyāsayogayuktena cetasā nānyagāminā .
paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ yāti pārthānucintayan ||8-8||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना |
परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् ||८-८||

verse_translation.life_application: Train your mind through daily practice not to wander, meditating constantly on the supreme divine person.

verse.transliteration:
kaviṃ purāṇamanuśāsitāraṃ aṇoraṇīyaṃsamanusmaredyaḥ .
sarvasya dhātāramacintyarūpaṃ ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt ||8-9||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार-
मणोरणीयंसमनुस्मरेद्यः |
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप-
मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् ||८-९||

verse_translation.life_application: Meditate on the omniscient, ancient ruler, subtler than the atom, sustainer of all, luminous like the sun beyond darkness.

verse.transliteration:
prayāṇakāle manasā.acalena bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva .
bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyak sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam ||8-10||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन
भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव |
भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्
स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् ||८-१०||

verse_translation.life_application: Focus your mind with devotion at the time of death, drawing life energy between the eyebrows to reach the Supreme.

verse.transliteration:
yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ .
yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa pravakṣye ||8-11||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति
विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः |
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति
तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये ||८-११||

verse_translation.life_application: Seek that imperishable goal which knowers of truth enter, for which ascetics practice self-control and celibacy.

verse.transliteration:
sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca .
mūdhnyā^^rdhāyātmanaḥ prāṇamāsthito yogadhāraṇām ||8-12||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च |
मूध्न्यार्धायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम् ||८-१२||

verse_translation.life_application: Control all sensory gates, lock the mind in the heart, and draw vital breath to the head, established in yoga.

verse.transliteration:
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharanmāmanusmaran .
yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||8-13||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन् |
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ||८-१३||

verse_translation.life_application: Utter the sacred sound while remembering the divine presence as you leave the body to attain the supreme goal.

verse.transliteration:
ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ .
tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ pārtha nityayuktasya yoginaḥ ||8-14||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः |
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः ||८-१४||

verse_translation.life_application: Remember God constantly with single-pointed attention today, making the supreme path easy to attain.

verse.transliteration:
māmupetya punarjanma duḥkhālayamaśāśvatam .
nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ ||8-15||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् |
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः ||८-१५||

verse_translation.life_application: Attain the supreme perfection in God so you never again return to this temporary world of sorrow.

verse.transliteration:
ābrahmabhuvanāllokāḥ punarāvartino.arjuna .
māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate ||8-16||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन |
मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ||८-१६||

verse_translation.life_application: Realize that all worlds up to the highest heaven are subject to return, but reaching God ends rebirth forever.

verse.transliteration:
sahasrayugaparyantamaharyad brahmaṇo viduḥ .
rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ te.ahorātravido janāḥ ||8-17||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद् ब्रह्मणो विदुः |
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः ||८-१७||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand cosmic time, where a single day or night of Brahma lasts a thousand cosmic ages.

verse.transliteration:
avyaktād vyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavantyaharāgame .
rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyaktasaṃjñake ||8-18||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अव्यक्ताद् व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे |
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके ||८-१८||

verse_translation.life_application: Recognize how all manifest beings emerge from the unmanifest at daybreak and dissolve back into it at nightfall.

verse.transliteration:
bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate .
rātryāgame.avaśaḥ pārtha prabhavatyaharāgame ||8-19||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते |
रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे ||८-१९||

verse_translation.life_application: See how the multitude of beings repeatedly comes into existence and dissolves helplessly at the cosmic night.

verse.transliteration:
parastasmāttu bhāvo.anyo.avyakto.avyaktātsanātanaḥ .
yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati ||8-20||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः |
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति ||८-२०||

verse_translation.life_application: Seek that unmanifest eternal state which exists beyond physical creation and is never destroyed when all perishes.

verse.transliteration:
avyakto.akṣara ityuktastamāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim .
yaṃ prāpya na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama ||8-21||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम् |
यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ||८-२१||

verse_translation.life_application: Make that imperishable unmanifest reality your supreme goal, from which those who reach it never return.

verse.transliteration:
puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā .
yasyāntaḥsthāni bhūtāni yena sarvamidaṃ tatam ||8-22||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया |
यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ||८-२२||

verse_translation.life_application: Attain that supreme divine person in whom all beings reside and by whom all is pervaded through unswerving devotion.

verse.transliteration:
yatra kāle tvanāvṛttimāvṛttiṃ caiva yoginaḥ .
prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha ||8-23||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः |
प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ ||८-२३||

verse_translation.life_application: Learn of the cosmic times and paths along which yogis depart, either to return or not to return.

verse.transliteration:
agnirjotirahaḥ śuklaḥ ṣaṇmāsā uttarāyaṇam .
tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ ||8-24||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अग्निर्जोतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् |
तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः ||८-२४||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand the bright path of light, fire, day, and northern sun, by which knowers of Brahman reach the Supreme.

verse.transliteration:
dhūmo rātristathā kṛṣṇaḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam .
tatra cāndramasaṃ jyotiryogī prāpya nivartate ||8-25||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् |
तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते ||८-२५||

verse_translation.life_application: Recognize the dark path of smoke, night, and southern sun, by which the practitioner attains lunar light and returns.

verse.transliteration:
śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate .
ekayā yātyanāvṛttimanyayāvartate punaḥ ||8-26||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते |
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः ||८-२६||

verse_translation.life_application: Know these two eternal paths of light and darkness, one leading to liberation and the other to rebirth.

verse.transliteration:
naite sṛtī pārtha jānanyogī muhyati kaścana .
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu yogayukto bhavārjuna ||8-27||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन |
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन ||८-२७||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand these two paths clearly so you are never deluded, remaining steadfast in yoga at all times.

verse.transliteration:
vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva dāneṣu yatpuṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam .
atyeti tatsarvamidaṃ viditvā yogī paraṃ sthānamupaiti cādyam ||8-28||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव
दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् |
अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा
योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् ||८-२८||

verse_translation.life_application: Rise above merit gained from rituals, charity, and austerities by gaining spiritual wisdom, reaching the primeval abode.

verse.transliteration: OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde akṣarabrahmayogo nāmāṣṭamo.adhyāyaḥ ||8-29||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
अक्षरब्रह्मयोगो नामाष्टमोऽध्यायः ||८||

verse_translation.life_application: Dedicate your daily awareness to the imperishable divine presence, securing ultimate peace beyond time and change.

verse.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca .
idaṃ tu te guhyatamaṃ pravakṣyāmyanasūyave .
jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ yajjñātvā mokṣyase.aśubhāt ||9-1||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे |
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् ||९-१||

verse_translation.life_application: Receive this profound secret knowledge with a non-carping mind, releasing yourself from all worldly evil.

verse.transliteration:
rājavidyā rājaguhyaṃ pavitramidamuttamam .
pratyakṣāvagamaṃ dharmyaṃ susukhaṃ kartumavyayam ||9-2||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम् |
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम् ||९-२||

verse_translation.life_application: Value this king of sciences and secrets as pure, directly realizable, righteous, easy to perform, and imperishable.

verse.transliteration:
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya parantapa .
aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani ||9-3||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप |
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि ||९-३||

verse_translation.life_application: Cultivate faith in spiritual truth, lest lacking faith you fail to reach God and remain trapped in mortality.

verse.transliteration:
mayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā .
matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ ||9-4||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना |
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः ||९-४||

verse_translation.life_application: Realize that God pervades this entire universe in unmanifest form; all beings exist in God, but God is not contained in them.

verse.transliteration:
na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram .
bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtastho mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ||9-5||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् |
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ||९-५||

verse_translation.life_application: Contemplate the divine mystery where beings do not constrain God, yet God sustains and creates all beings.

verse.transliteration:
yathākāśasthito nityaṃ vāyuḥ sarvatrago mahān .
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni matsthānītyupadhāraya ||9-6||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् |
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय ||९-६||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand that just as the mighty wind blowing everywhere rests in space, so all beings rest in God.

verse.transliteration:
sarvabhūtāni kaunteya prakṛtiṃ yānti māmikām .
kalpakṣaye punastāni kalpādau visṛjāmyaham ||9-7||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम् |
कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम् ||९-७||

verse_translation.life_application: Recognize how all beings enter physical nature at the end of a cosmic cycle and are created anew at the start.

verse.transliteration:
prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya visṛjāmi punaḥ punaḥ .
bhūtagrāmamimaṃ kṛtsnamavaśaṃ prakṛtervaśāt ||9-8||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः |
भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् ||९-८||

verse_translation.life_application: Contemplate how divine power repeatedly projects the multitude of beings according to their natural karma.

verse.transliteration:
na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya .
udāsīnavadāsīnamasaktaṃ teṣu karmasu ||9-9||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय |
उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु ||९-९||

verse_translation.life_application: Remain unattached and indifferent like the divine presence, untouched by the cosmic work you perform.

verse.transliteration:
mayādhyakṣeṇa prakṛtiḥ sūyate sacarācaram .
hetunānena kaunteya jagadviparivartate ||9-10||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् |
हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते ||९-१०||

verse_translation.life_application: See nature working under divine supervision to produce moving and unmoving things, keeping the world revolving.

verse.transliteration:
avajānanti māṃ mūḍhā mānuṣīṃ tanumāśritam .
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mama bhūtamaheśvaram ||9-11||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम् |
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ||९-११||

verse_translation.life_application: Do not disregard the divine presence when masked in human form, failing to know God's supreme nature.

verse.transliteration:
moghāśā moghakarmāṇo moghajñānā vicetasaḥ .
rākṣasīmāsurīṃ caiva prakṛtiṃ mohinīṃ śritāḥ ||9-12||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः |
राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः ||९-१२||

verse_translation.life_application: Avoid vain hopes, vain actions, and vain knowledge that spring from a deluded, materialistic, and arrogant mindset.

verse.transliteration:
mahātmānastu māṃ pārtha daivīṃ prakṛtimāśritāḥ .
bhajantyananyamanaso jñātvā bhūtādimavyayam ||9-13||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः |
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् ||९-१३||

verse_translation.life_application: Embrace a noble nature, worshipping God with single-pointed devotion as the imperishable origin of all.

verse.transliteration:
satataṃ kīrtayanto māṃ yatantaśca dṛḍhavratāḥ .
namasyantaśca māṃ bhaktyā nityayuktā upāsate ||9-14||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः |
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ||९-१४||

verse_translation.life_application: Glorify God constantly, striving with firm resolve, bowing down with love, ever devoted in worship.

verse.transliteration:
jñānayajñena cāpyanye yajanto māmupāsate .
ekatvena pṛthaktvena bahudhā viśvatomukham ||9-15||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते |
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् ||९-१५||

verse_translation.life_application: Worship God through the sacrifice of knowledge, seeing the divine as one, as distinct, or as multifaceted.

verse.transliteration:
ahaṃ kraturahaṃ yajñaḥ svadhāhamahamauṣadham .
mantro.ahamahamevājyamahamagnirahaṃ hutam ||9-16||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम् |
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् ||९-१६||

verse_translation.life_application: Recognize God as the ritual, sacrifice, offering, healing herb, sacred chant, clarified butter, fire, and oblation.

verse.transliteration:
pitāhamasya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ .
vedyaṃ pavitramoṃkāra ṛksāma yajureva ca ||9-17||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः |
वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च ||९-१७||

verse_translation.life_application: Honor God as the father, mother, sustainer, grandfather, purifier, sacred syllable, and ancient scripture.

verse.transliteration:
gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt .
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam ||9-18||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् |
प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् ||९-१८||

verse_translation.life_application: Know God as the goal, supporter, Lord, witness, abode, refuge, friend, origin, dissolution, foundation, and seed.

verse.transliteration:
tapāmyahamahaṃ varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmyutsṛjāmi ca .
amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuśca sadasaccāhamarjuna ||9-19||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च |
अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन ||९-१९||

verse_translation.life_application: See God giving heat, withholding and sending rain, being both immortality and death, existence and non-existence.

verse.transliteration:
traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante .
te puṇyamāsādya surendralokaṃ aśnanti divyāndivi devabhogān ||9-20||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा
यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते |
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक-
मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् ||९-२०||

verse_translation.life_application: Realize that seeking heavenly pleasures through rituals brings only temporary enjoyment before returning to mortal life.

verse.transliteration:
te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti .
evaṃ trayīdharmamanuprapannā gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante ||9-21||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं
क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति |
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ||९-२१||

verse_translation.life_application: Seek eternal spiritual fulfillment rather than exhausting temporary merits in fleeting celestial realms.

verse.transliteration:
ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate .
teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham ||9-22||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते |
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ||९-२२||

verse_translation.life_application: Think of God constantly with undivided devotion; for those ever-united, God carries what they lack and preserves what they have.

verse.transliteration:
ye.apyanyadevatābhaktā yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ .
te.api māmeva kaunteya yajantyavidhipūrvakam ||9-23||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः |
तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम् ||९-२३||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand that even those who worship other deities with faith are indirectly worshipping the one divine source.

verse.transliteration:
ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca .
na tu māmabhijānanti tattvenātaścyavanti te ||9-24||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च |
न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते ||९-२४||

verse_translation.life_application: Remember that God is the sole enjoyer and Lord of all sacrifices; failing to recognize this leads to falling back.

verse.transliteration:
yānti devavratā devānpitṝnyānti pitṛvratāḥ .
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino.api mām ||9-25||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यान्ति देवव्रता देवान्पितॄन्यान्ति पितृव्रताः |
भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम् ||९-२५||

verse_translation.life_application: Know that worshippers of gods go to gods, ancestor worshippers to ancestors, but God's devotees come directly to God.

verse.transliteration:
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati .
tadahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtamaśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ ||9-26||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति |
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ||९-२६||

verse_translation.life_application: Offer a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water with love and devotion, which God gladly accepts from a pure heart.

verse.transliteration:
yatkaroṣi yadaśnāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat .
yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruṣva madarpaṇam ||9-27||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत् |
यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ||९-२७||

verse_translation.life_application: Whatever you do, eat, offer in sacrifice, give away, or practice as austerity—do it as an offering to God.

verse.transliteration:
śubhāśubhaphalairevaṃ mokṣyase karmabandhanaiḥ .
saṃnyāsayogayuktātmā vimukto māmupaiṣyasi ||9-28||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः |
संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि ||९-२८||

verse_translation.life_application: Free yourself from the bondage of good and bad action fruits through renunciation, attaining liberation and reaching God.

verse.transliteration:
samo.ahaṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo.asti na priyaḥ .
ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham ||9-29||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः |
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ||९-२९||

verse_translation.life_application: Realize God is equal to all beings, hating none and favoring none; yet those who worship with love abide in God.

verse.transliteration:
api cetsudurācāro bhajate māmananyabhāk .
sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ ||9-30||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक् |
साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ||९-३०||

verse_translation.life_application: Even if a person of bad conduct worships God with undivided devotion, consider them righteous, for they have resolved rightly.

verse.transliteration:
kṣipraṃ bhavati dharmātmā śaśvacchāntiṃ nigacchati .
kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati ||9-31||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति |
कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ||९-३१||

verse_translation.life_application: Trust that genuine devotion quickly transforms a person into a righteous soul; God's devotee never perishes.

verse.transliteration:
māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye.api syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ .
striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste.api yānti parāṃ gatim ||9-32||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः |
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ||९-३२||

verse_translation.life_application: Take refuge in God regardless of your social background or past, for all who surrender reach the supreme destination.

verse.transliteration:
kiṃ punarbrāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣayastathā .
anityamasukhaṃ lokamimaṃ prāpya bhajasva mām ||9-33||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा |
अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम् ||९-३३||

verse_translation.life_application: How much more then should noble seekers turn to God; having entered this transient unhappy world, worship the Divine.

verse.transliteration:
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru .
māmevaiṣyasi yuktvaivamātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ ||9-34||

verse_text.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verse_text.slok:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु |
मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः ||९-३४||
